transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because I’ve been having a hard time since I moved into this busted-up room. I’m up at night dealing with leaks or the heat not working, and then I’m dragging the next day, showing up late to work, messing up things I usually handle fine. I’ve also been snapping at people more than normal.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?

Yeah, I have. Since moving into that busted-up room, I feel wound up a lot. I’m up at night dealing with the leaks or the heat, then I’m tired, late to work, and messing up stuff I usually don’t. I’ve been snapping at people too, more than I normally would.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or worries that you can't seem to get out of your head?
I mean, I worry about stuff, yeah, but I don’t know if I’d call it thoughts I can’t get out of my head. It’s more just when something comes up, I think about it, and then I try to move on.
Do you find yourself worrying about a lot of different things?
I don’t think it’s a lot of different things, no. It’s mostly whatever’s right in front of me at the time. I haven’t really noticed myself worrying about everything across the board.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual?
Yeah, definitely. I’ve been up at night dealing with that room, like the leaks or the heat, and then I’m dragging the next day. I’ve been late to work and messing up things I normally handle fine.
Have you experienced any panic attacks recently?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve felt stressed, but I haven’t had anything I’d call a panic attack.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind?
Not really. I mean, I think about stuff when it comes up, but I haven’t noticed the same thought playing over and over in my head or anything like that.
Have you been having difficulty sleeping?

Yeah. Since I moved into that busted-up room, I’ve been up at night dealing with stuff like leaks or the heat, so I’m not sleeping right. Then I’m dragging the next day, late to work, messing up things I usually do fine.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel compelled to think about over and over?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t feel like I’m forced to keep thinking about anything over and over.
Do you feel like you're thinking about things over and over even when you don't want to?
No, not like that. I might think about something if it’s right in front of me, but I don’t feel stuck on it when I don’t want to be.
Do you feel like there are any thoughts that you cannot control?
No, I wouldn’t say that. I can control my thoughts fine. I’m just dealing with stuff when it comes up, but it’s not like my thoughts are taking over or anything.
Do you have thoughts that you try to ignore or suppress?
Not really. I mean, if something bothers me I might try not to dwell on it, but I don’t have thoughts that I’m fighting to push away or anything like that.
Do you have any thoughts that keep bothering you even when you try to think about something else?
No, I haven’t really noticed that. If something’s bothering me, I can usually put it aside for a while or focus on what I’m doing. It doesn’t keep coming back over and over like that.
Do you have any thoughts that keep coming back to you even when you're trying to focus on other things?

No, not really. I mean, stuff comes to mind sometimes, but if I’m trying to work or do something else, I can usually just keep going. It doesn’t feel like the same thought keeps forcing its way back in.
Do you have any thoughts that you feel are intrusive or unwanted?
No, I don’t think so. I get worried or stressed like anybody, but I wouldn’t call the thoughts intrusive or unwanted like that.
Have you been having trouble staying asleep once you fall asleep?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed a pattern with that. Once I’m asleep, I guess I usually just sleep, but I haven’t been paying close attention to it.
Do you think you would be sleeping better if your living situation was more comfortable?

Yeah, I think so. Since I moved into that busted-up room, I’m up dealing with stuff like leaks or trying to get the heat working, and then I’m dragging the next day. I’ve been late to work and messing up things I’d normally handle fine. I’m also snapping at people more, so yeah, if the place was more comfortable, I think I’d sleep better.
Do you think your sleep would improve if you didn't have to deal with the issues in your room?

Yeah, I think it would. Most of the sleep problem feels tied to that room. I’m staying up trying to deal with leaks or the heat, and then I’m worn out the next day, late to work, messing up stuff I normally wouldn’t. It’s been making me more short with people too.
Do you think you would be able to sleep normally if you were in a different living situation?

Yeah, I think so. If I wasn’t in that busted-up room, I don’t think I’d be up dealing with leaks or trying to get the heat working. That’s what’s been throwing me off—then I’m dragging the next day, showing up late to work, messing up stuff I usually handle fine, and getting short with people. So yeah, I think a different place would help me sleep normal.
Do you think your sleep problems are the main reason you're struggling with daily activities and mood?

Yeah, I think the sleep is a big part of it, but it’s all tied together with that room. Since I moved into that busted-up place, I’m staying up dealing with leaks or trying to get the heat working, then I’m dragging the next day. I end up late to work, messing up stuff I normally handle, and I’m snapping at people more.
